title: Reopen request
purpose: Return an approved request to draft so it can be changed and decided again.
summary: Return an approved request to draft so it can be changed and decided again. Managers and administrators only.

tasks.title: Clear what blocks reopening
steps: Put picked specimens back and unpack shipments first. The form says which.

good_to_know: It needs a new submission and decision.
Allocations stay, but cannot be picked or shipped until it is approved again.
The reason is kept in the timeline.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Managers and administrators, while the request is approved and nothing is picked for it or packed in a shipment (put picked specimens back and unpack first; the form says which). It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, kept in the timeline and history. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: The request becomes a draft again and needs a new submission and decision. Its allocations stay, but they cannot be picked, packed or dispatched until the request is approved again; if the resubmission is rejected, they are released with their holds.
If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
